hearthford.title: The Mill Race Compact
hearthford.lead: Mara's flood marks point to the Flood-islet cache south of the road loop.
final: Bind the mill labour and sluice as a public compact
Recognise the reeve's faster private repair claim

greywash.title: The Ledger Beneath the Ebb
greywash.lead: Edda names the Distinctive wreck locker on the low road before the tide covers it.
final: Wait for the safer delayed salt road
Take the ebb salvage while the chain route is exposed
open the wreck locker or dog the tide chain

greenwold.title: A Fire Kept to Its Bounds
greenwold.lead: Nera's bird counts mark a Canopy cache above the western clearing.
final: Save the medicine coppice and narrow the burn
Feed the charcoal contract and accept a wider managed burn

whitecairn.title: The Honest Bell
whitecairn.lead: Pera's load marks identify the Ridge bridge coffer above the quarry hoist.
final: Ring an honest warning and close the unstable face
Expose the false toll with recovered quarry evidence
recover the bridge coffer or brace the quarry

dunmire.title: The Ground Owed to Water
dunmire.lead: Deren's drain marks lead from the store cellar to the buried peat strongbox.
final: Breach the drying bank; save the islands, lose this fuel yield
Hold the drying bank and honour the winter fuel obligation
brace the drying control or recover the drain record

rillscar.title: A Bridge with Two Owners
rillscar.lead: Vessa kept the bridge load account in the Weatherward roof coffer, above the cutworks.
final: Open the tailrace and retire the private bridge guard
Bind the two bridge claims with the recovered load account
secure the upper coffer or brace the tailrace control

marlbank.title: The Kiln and the Seed Bed
marlbank.lead: Odrin's Witnessed market coffer records which kiln water also feeds the seed terraces.
final: Give the release to the fields; cool the working kilns
Preserve the kiln firing and ration the seed terraces
read the water account or operate the release

frostmere.title: The Last Marked Channel
frostmere.lead: Brenna's sounding board rests in the Loft survey cabinet, above the winter nets.
final: Mark the long lee channel; shelter the nets and delay trade
Open the direct ice cut under a witnessed pilot obligation
recover the sounding board or secure the ice control
